dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Do you find the dating chính sách in Vietnam a bit strange? In Russia, we don't have so many complicated rules.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Actually, every place has its own chính sách about relationships. I notice Vietnamese people tend to want to meet family early, while in America it's much more relaxed. But I think what matters is the real feelings between two people.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Feelings? Men like you always talk about feelings but understand nothing. My chính sách is to find a man who knows how to tôn trọng truyền thống values. Do you think you're that type of person?

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: I tôn trọng truyền thống values, but I also believe in equality. Perhaps our dating chính sách could be a combination - both tôn trọng truyền thống while still being open to new ideas. But... wait, why are we talking about this anyway?

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: I... I'm just discussing! Don't misunderstand! I'm not suggesting anything. By the way, would you like to go to an art exhibition next week? I heard they'll have works by Russian artists too...
